name: Hao-Yuan Chuang
current_role: Chief Financial Officer & Director, Belite Bio, Inc. (Nasdaq: BLTE)
profile: Hao-Yuan Chuang has been CFO of Belite Bio, a San Diego/Taiwan-linked clinical-stage biotech developing tinlarebant for Stargardt disease and geographic atrophy, since April 2020 and a director since Nov 2021. He previously was CFO of parent Lin BioScience (TPEx: 6696). His wealth is tied to Belite equity; Belite has submitted an NDA for tinlarebant in Stargardt disease.
interesting_fact: Belite Bio completed a rolling NDA submission to the US FDA for tinlarebant, an oral drug for Stargardt disease, a juvenile macular degeneration with no approved therapy.
deep_cut_fact: Before biotech he worked in institutional investing: Investment Director at Suning International and Portfolio Manager at The People's Insurance Company (Group) of China; he holds a triple MBA (Columbia, London Business School, HKU) plus CFA and FRM.
notes: Low public profile; no personal social accounts found. Best route is Belite IR (Jennifer Wu, ir@belitebio.com). Biotech, not energy/data-center.

name: Martin Hoffmann
current_role: Former CEO (stepped down 1 May 2026), now advisor through March 2027 and shareholder, On Holding AG (NYSE: ONON)
profile: Martin Hoffmann joined Swiss running-shoe brand On as CFO in July 2013, became co-CEO in 2021 and sole CEO in July 2025, helping take On from startup to a NYSE-listed global brand (IPO 2021). He stepped down effective May 1, 2026 for a planned hiatus and philanthropic interests; co-founders David Allemann and Caspar Coppetti became co-CEOs.
interesting_fact: He spent 13 years as On's CFO and about five as co-/sole CEO; on leaving he said 'The timing to move on feels right' and planned to focus on philanthropy while staying an advisor until March 2027.
deep_cut_fact: Before joining a then-tiny On in 2013 he was CFO of Swiss kiosk/retail group Valora (2009-2013); he studied business management and computer science at TU Kaiserslautern.
notes: No longer CEO as of May 2026; reach via On press (press@on.com) while he remains advisor. No verified personal social accounts found. Swiss-based.

name: Craig Vosburg
current_role: Vice Chair and global ambassador, Mastercard (since Aug 3, 2026; previously Chief Services Officer)
profile: Craig Vosburg is a 20+ year Mastercard executive who has been president of North America, chief product officer and, from 2024, chief services officer running a services portfolio of nearly 40% of revenue (fraud, cybersecurity, data & analytics, open finance, AI strategy). In Aug 2026 he became vice chair and global ambassador, focusing on senior customer relationships and AI transformation.
interesting_fact: As chief services officer he oversaw Mastercard's AI strategy and the Mastercard Economics Institute, in a services business that grew to nearly 40% of the company's revenue.
deep_cut_fact: He started at Mastercard in Singapore in its advisory/consulting arm after stints at Bain, A.T. Kearney and CoreStates; he sits on the board of the Sultana Education Foundation and is a former Hawaiian Airlines director and David Rockefeller Fellow.
notes: Route via Mastercard global communications. Relevant angle: AI/data services and cybersecurity at payments scale.

name: Trevor Fetter
current_role: Senior Lecturer & Henry B. Arthur Fellow, Harvard Business School; Lead Director, The Hartford; Director, Omada Health
profile: Trevor Fetter was Chairman and CEO of Tenet Healthcare, a ~$20B hospital/healthcare services company, retiring in late 2017; earlier he was Tenet's CFO, CFO of MGM, and founder/CEO of hospital supply-chain firm Broadlane. Since 2019 he has taught required MBA courses at HBS and serves as lead director of The Hartford and a director of Omada Health and TowerBrook portfolio company TRIMEDX.
interesting_fact: Before running one of the largest US hospital chains, he was CFO of Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer, moving from Hollywood finance to healthcare.
deep_cut_fact: He serves on the boards of the Catalina Island Conservancy and the Santa Catalina Island Company, as well as the Smithsonian National Board and Stanford Medicine's Board of Fellows.
notes: Reported to have been named HBS Faculty Chair, MBA Academic and Student Affairs in 2026 (per HBS profile snippet, unverified directly). HBS teaching material includes a TXU LBO case (energy angle) but authorship not confirmed. Best route: HBS faculty office.

name: John E Sanfilippo
current_role: Director (since Oct 2020) and 10%+ holder, John B. Sanfilippo & Son (Nasdaq: JBSS); President of Engineering, VIST Labs, LLC
profile: John E. Sanfilippo is a member of the founding family of John B. Sanfilippo & Son, the Elgin, Illinois nut processor behind Fisher, Orchard Valley Harvest and Squirrel Brand, founded as a Chicago pecan-shelling storefront in 1922. A packaging engineer by career, he is President of Engineering at VIST Labs (advanced packaging systems) and joined the JBSS board in 2020.
interesting_fact: JBSS began in 1922 when Gaspare Sanfilippo and his son John opened a small pecan-shelling storefront in Chicago; it is now a vertically integrated global nut supplier that owns the Fisher brand.
deep_cut_fact: He started as an engineer at the family company (1975-1999, including as a plant engineer), then built a separate packaging career: Group President of Corporate Engineering at Clear Lam Packaging until its 2017 sale to Sonoco, then VP Engineering at Sonoco's Elk Grove division.

public_contacts.value: Three Part Advisors, LLC (John Beisler / Steven Hooser), IR agency

notes: Private, low-profile family-member director; no personal social accounts found. Web search quota exhausted mid-lane; research based on company site.
